title: Metaculus Open Forecasting Questions
description:
Snapshots open Metaculus forecasting questions sorted by community engagement (prediction count). Each row identifies a question with id, title, question_type (binary / numeric / date), the latest community_prediction (median for binary as a 0-1 probability, central tendency for numeric), the number of forecasts and comments, time-to-resolution, primary category tag, and url. Powers the Science & Forecasting Community Brief: Metaculus has historically produced calibrated probability forecasts for events that move equity sectors days-to-weeks before consensus catches up (election outcomes, AI capability milestones, vaccine timelines, geopolitical escalations).

Auth: Metaculus deprecated unauthenticated API access in 2026-Q1 - every /api*/ path returns 403 'Permission Error: The API is only available to authenticated users.' Provide a METACULUS_API_TOKEN credential (free, from your account settings) to authenticate requests. If the credential is missing the script emits a single AUTH_REQUIRED sentinel row with instructions instead of silently writing zero rows.

Schema: as of the V2 migration the response moved to a posts/projects model - question-specific data is nested under `q.question` (e.g. type, aggregations, resolve_time), categories moved to `q.projects.category[]`, and several fields were renamed (prediction_count -> forecasts_count, created_time -> created_at, publish_time -> published_at, resolve_time -> scheduled_resolve_time). The script reads the new paths first and falls back to legacy paths for backward compatibility with older test fixtures.
